scope: Initial native probe smoke; failed result preserved, not certification
findings: Actual exec probes can be interrupted during runtime setup because gr8s applied command timeoutSeconds to the whole CRI RPC. Kubernetes preserves the command budget but permits runtimeRequestTimeout + commandTimeout for the RPC. Production correction pending.

Initial liveness zero-exit restart and healthy sibling preservation occurred, but its first stopped attempt was triggered by an infrastructure timeout; this is not accepted as proof of intended command-failure behavior.

Event listing order is not attempt order; the original harness selected a later attempt Event and accepted a negative stop interval. The corrected harness requires an actual nonzero-command Event during the stopped attempt lifetime.

Containerd log proves the exact TERM-ignoring attempt received StopContainer timeout3 at03:10:13.368 and physically exited137 at03:10:16.471. API timestamp precision yields2.631889seconds after stop request. The initial harness incorrectly measured Event-to-exit latency, including queued reconciliation.
nextValidation: Rerun the complete strict native harness after pinned CRI command/RPC timeout and prober-error retry fixes; all earlier failures remain preserved.
